AI Agents That Power Effortless Customer Experience at Scale
Experience the speed, accuracy, and always-on service only Agentic AI can
deliver—faster answers, better CX, zero wait time.


Seamless Everyday Banking Agent
An enterprise-grade AI assistant built for digital-first banks. Automate high-volume and high-value banking interactions, giving customers instant answers, faster resolutions, 24/7 support, and effortless self-service, while reducing service costs and operational effort.

Callbots for Always-On Service
Deliver human-like, multilingual voice support for tasks like overseas fund transfers, giving customers faster responses, shorter wait times, and smooth, accurate 24/7 assistance. Leverage sentiment analysis, reduce wait times, and lower servicing costs while ensuring compliant, frictionless conversations at scale.

Insurance
Claims & Advisory Agent
An AI agent that simplifies insurance servicing by authenticating users, managing documents, and tracking claims. It also explains complex policies and suggests optimal coverage.

Loan Processing & Support Agent
A virtual loan assistant that verifies eligibility, validates documents, handles loan queries, and categorizes loan types to streamline origination and servicing.

Motor Insurance Agent
Deploy a plug-and-play AI motor insurance agent that simplifies every step of the customer journey. Deliver instant, personalized assistance to reduce drop-offs, improve CX, and drive higher conversion rates.

Build Your Own AI Agent
Design custom AI agents tailored to your processes—whether it's for customer onboarding, policy advisory, claims, or financial servicing.

About Intense Technologies Limited

‍Intense Technologies is a publicly listed, AI-first, Platform-driven Services Company specializing in mission-critical solutions for communications, data management, and process automation across the BFSI, Telecom, and Government sectors. Through its innovative platforms, the company impacts a billion lives daily and processes over $25 billion in revenue data annually. Recognized by leading industry analysts such as Gartner, IDC, Aspire, Celent, and Omdia, Intense continues to empower enterprises with best-in-class IP-enabled platforms and services to help them achieve their digital-first goals. Serving clients across four continents, Intense Technologies has helped leading banks achieve three-digit crore savings by centralizing and optimizing their customer communication processes. The company handles the delivery of 1 billion notifications annually, generates 50 million statements monthly, and has successfully onboarded over 1 billion subscribers.
